name: grades
description: Web application for viewing and comparing NTNU courses and grades (grades.no).
author: Dotkom <dotkom@online.ntnu> (https://online.ntnu.no)

scripts.dev: pnpm -rc --parallel -F @grades/backend -F @grades/frontend exec doppler run --preserve-env pnpm run dev
scripts.prisma: doppler run --config dev --project grades-backend --preserve-env -- pnpm -F @grades/db prisma
scripts.generate: doppler run --config dev --project grades-backend --preserve-env -- pnpm -F @grades/db generate
scripts.migrate:dev: doppler run --config dev --project grades-backend --preserve-env -- pnpm -F @grades/db migrate
scripts.migrate:dev-with-fixtures: doppler run --config dev --project grades-backend --preserve-env -- pnpm -F @grades/db prisma migrate dev && doppler run --config dev --project grades-backend --preserve-env -- pnpm -F @grades/db apply-fixtures
scripts.migrate:deploy: doppler run --config prd --project grades-backend --preserve-env -- pnpm -F @grades/db prisma migrate deploy
scripts.migrate:prod: doppler run --config prd --project grades-backend -- pnpm migrate:deploy
scripts.sync:dev: doppler run --config dev --project grades-backend --preserve-env -- pnpm -F @grades/backend sync-grades
scripts.migrate-old-grades-data:dev: doppler run --config dev --project grades-backend --preserve-env -- pnpm -F @grades/backend migrate-old-grades-data
scripts.seed-aliases:dev: doppler run --config dev --project grades-backend --preserve-env -- pnpm -F @grades/backend seed-aliases
scripts.seed-aliases:prod: doppler run --config prd --project grades-backend --preserve-env -- pnpm -F @grades/backend seed-aliases
scripts.recalculate-course-statistics:dev: doppler run --config dev --project grades-backend --preserve-env -- pnpm -F @grades/backend recalculate-course-statistics
scripts.docker:login: aws ecr get-login-password --region eu-north-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 891459268445.dkr.ecr.eu-north-1.amazonaws.com
